comment: Wabcut model registry (docs/ai.md). Prices are USD per 1M tokens / per audio minute. 'verified' means id, endpoint and prices were checked against the vendor documentation in 'source' on the 'updated' date. Cache prices are omitted on purpose: estimates then bill cached tokens at the input rate, which errs on the safe side for spend caps.
